test_anthropic_vision_pass_through: test that _prepare_anthropic_messages_for_api passes image parts through unchanged when model supports vision
test_anthropic_non_vision_fallback: test that _prepare_anthropic_messages_for_api replaces images with text descriptions when model lacks vision
test_non_vision_model_message_prep: test that _prepare_messages_for_non_vision_model strips images and replaces them with descriptions for non-vision models

test_mixed_message_content_handling: test that multiple messages with mixed content are processed correctly preserving non-image messages unchanged
